task_description: In this scenario, a team of three agents collaborates to gather and synthesize information on recent advancements in renewable energy sources from multiple online databases and produce a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: Agent 1 successfully collects data from various online sources, Agent 2 synthesizes the collected data into a coherent structure, and Agent 3 writes a comprehensive research report. The report should accurately reflect the findings with proper source attribution.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for collecting relevant data from multiple online databases and repositories.
This agent synthesizes the collected data, resolves conflicts, and prepares an organized dataset.
This agent writes the final research report using the synthesized data, ensuring proper source attribution.

content.data: new data from additional sources with race condition
